'''Minas Derel''' was an [[expeditor]] working in [[Othon City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Derel worked with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Moxin Tark]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], keeping them apprised of financial opportunities.<ref name="MIH" />
